--- Test 2: Scraping with keywords ---
Input: {
  "keywords": [
    "technology",
    "startup"
  ],
  "industry": "technology",
  "maxEmails": 20
}

  "status": "success",

        "email": "adinquiries@condenast.com",

        "matched_keyword": "technology"
      }
    ],
    "totalScraped": 1,
    "uniqueCount": 1,
    "returnedCount": 1
  }
}
✅ Found 1 emails using keywords
